title: ericoides conicum
intro: Ericoides conicum, commonly known as Conyza canadensis, is a flowering plant species native to North America, often found in wetlands and along streams. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include reducing fever, relieving coughs, and soothing irritated skin, making it a valuable remedy for skin conditions like eczema and acne. The bioactive constituents of Ericoides conicum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
